item.title: Greetings from a wildlife park in central Sri Lanka that's a haven for elephants
item.description: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.
item.content:encoded: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.

item.title: Trump administration moves to deregulate Head Start, opening door for sweeping change
item.description: It would slim regulation of the 60-year-old anti-poverty program and aim to save money. Advocates worry the changes could undermine the early education program's mission.

item.title: How Cambodia became the first Asian country to hit an elusive HIV target
item.description: The United Nations has set a goal for near universal HIV diagnosis and treatment for all by 2030. No country in Asia has hit the mark — until this year.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan's primary. And, Fauci faces contempt of Congress vote
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary and will face Republican Congressman Mike Rogers in the midterms. And, today, Dr. Anthony Fauci faces a contempt of Congress vote.

item.title: Celebrity culture is one thing. For TMZ, Congress is the new 'reality show'
item.description: TMZ is trading Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with a new D.C. bureau, launched in April. The online tabloid's two-man crew has brought an unconventional reporting style to the Congress beat.

item.title: Gianni Infantino gets internal support at crisis meeting to remain as FIFA president
item.description: FIFA said Wednesday it had apologized for errors made over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and that senior staff in attendance at a crisis meeting in Morocco "reaffirmed their full support" for his presidency.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: STR/AP Photo)
